caption: The drawing depicts an ornamental leather object, likely a horse saddle or decorative tack with a curved, asymmetrical outline. The main body is rendered in varying shades of light brown, simulating the appearance of leather. It features a detailed painted border consisting of blue, white, and golden-yellow scrollwork and floral designs. At the upper center, there is an illustration of a figure in ancient-style clothing, holding a whip or reins, riding in a green chariot pulled by two green horses over a cloud-like formation. Below and slightly to the right, on the larger lower area, there is an elaborate heraldic or symbolic emblem with green leaves or floral motifs, and a shield-like shape in the center containing stylized images in muted green, yellow, and gold tones. The object is adorned with leather straps and buckles, depicted in various positions, some draping loosely across the surface. The background is a plain, light beige color without additional elements, and the artist's name, "Rose Campbell Clarke," is written in small, faint red lettering at the lower left.
title: Saddle
